subject: Physics
text: An electric dipole of moment $\vec{p}$ is placed in a uniform electric field $\vec{E}$. The torque acting on the dipole is:
solution: Torque on a dipole is given by $\vec{\tau} = \vec{p} \times \vec{E}$.

subject: Mathematics
text: The value of $\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{\sin x}{\sin x + \cos x} dx$ is:
solution: Using King's rule $\int_0^a f(x)dx = \int_0^a f(a-x)dx$, $2I = \frac{\pi}{2} \implies I = \frac{\pi}{4}$.

subject: Physics
text: A body of mass $m$ accelerates uniformly from rest to speed $v$ in time $T$. The instantaneous power delivered at time $t$ is:
solution: Acceleration $a = \frac{v}{T}$. Force $F = ma = \frac{mv}{T}$. Velocity $v(t) = at = \frac{vt}{T}$. Power $P = F v(t) = \frac{mv^2 t}{T^2}$.
